lines: Concrete, a machine gun, and a flag on every roof. On both sides.
Both headquarters gave the same order. Knock them out.
Every shell the front can carry goes to the guns tonight.
Two near misses. Then one direct hit, and the concrete is rubble.
By morning, the side that fired more turns the enemy pillboxes into ruins.
Your comment is a shell. Comment HEGEMONY or CONCORD.
Every comment counts. New here? Your first comment enlists you.
The Trench Gazette counts the shells. Fire!
